summary: This note is a Wikipedia-style biography of American actress Alyson Hannigan, born March 24, 1974, in Washington, D.C. It covers her family background, her early start in commercials and her move to Hollywood at age 11, and her education at North Hollywood High School and California State University, Northridge. It also traces her early film and television roles and names her best-known parts as Willow Rosenberg on Buffy the Vampire Slayer, Lily Aldrin on How I Met Your Mother, and Michelle Flaherty in the American Pie films.
one_line: Biography of American actress Alyson Hannigan, known for Buffy the Vampire Slayer, How I Met Your Mother, and American Pie.
key_facts: Alyson Lee Hannigan was born March 24, 1974, in Washington, D.C.
Alyson Hannigan is the only child of Emilie (Posner) Haas, a real estate agent, and Alan Hannigan, a Teamsters trucker.
Alyson Hannigan's father is of Irish ancestry and her mother is Jewish.
Alyson Hannigan began appearing in commercials at age four.
Alyson Hannigan moved to Hollywood at age 11.
Alyson Hannigan attended North Hollywood High School while living with her mother.
Alyson Hannigan successfully auditioned for agents while visiting her father in Santa Barbara.
Alyson Hannigan attended California State University, Northridge, where she was a member of the Alpha Chi Omega sorority and earned a degree in psychology.
Alyson Hannigan's first major film role was in My Stepmother Is an Alien, a science-fiction comedy released in 1988.
Seth Green co-starred with Alyson Hannigan in My Stepmother Is an Alien and later played her on-screen boyfriend on Buffy the Vampire Slayer.
In 1989, Alyson Hannigan was cast in the short-lived ABC sitcom Free Spirit, her first regular role on a TV series.
As a teenager, Alyson Hannigan babysat for the children of Bob Saget, who later became her How I Met Your Mother costar.
Alyson Hannigan played Willow Rosenberg on the television series Buffy the Vampire Slayer from 1997 to 2003.
Alyson Hannigan played Lily Aldrin on the sitcom How I Met Your Mother from 2005 to 2014 and won a People's Choice Award in 2009 for the role.
Alyson Hannigan played Michelle Flaherty in the American Pie film series from 1999 to 2012.
